meta.name: shadcn
meta.description: Manages shadcn components and projects — adding, searching, fixing, debugging, styling, and composing UI, including chat interfaces. Provides project context, component docs, and usage examples. Applies when working with shadcn/ui, component registries, presets, --preset codes, or any project with a components.json file. Also triggers for "shadcn init", "create an app with --preset", or "switch to --preset".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 添加、修复、调整界面组件,快速搭建标准化的前端页面。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在搭建网页界面,需要反复添加和调整现成的界面组件。
copy.tagline_en: Add, fix, and style UI components to streamline building frontend pages.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build web interfaces and want to easily manage and adjust UI components.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会帮你用 shadcn/ui 方式添加、查找、修改和调试界面组件。它会先查看你项目的 components.json 配置,再按一整套固定规则(如用现成组件、统一间距方式、语义颜色)来写代码,并运行 npx shadcn 等命令。
howto.when: 当你在使用 shadcn/ui、组件注册表、preset 代码、有 components.json 的项目,或提到 “shadcn init / --preset” 时接管。

say.text: 帮我添加一个登录表单块,不加任何预设组件
say.note: 若未指定注册表,Claude 会先询问用哪个来源。

say.text: 给我写出带气泡和回复区的聊天界面组件
say.note: 会按项目里的 chat 原语(如 Bubble)组合。

say.text: 把项目当前用的 preset 信息查出来
say.note: 会运行 preset resolve 读取配置。

howto.what_en: Helps add, find, fix, and compose shadcn/ui components. It reads the project's components.json, follows fixed rules (reuse components, gap spacing, semantic colors), and runs npx/pnpm/bunx shadcn commands.
howto.when_en: Takes over when working with shadcn/ui, component registries, preset codes, or any project with components.json. Also on "shadcn init", "create an app with --preset".

say_en.text: Add a login form block for my project.
say_en.note: Asks which registry to use if none is specified.

say_en.text: Compose a chat UI with bubbles and a reply area.
say_en.note: Uses the project's chat primitives such as Bubble.

say_en.text: Show the current preset info for this project.
say_en.note: Runs preset resolve to read the config.
